subject: Fractal Health: entity-aware billing setup & remit lanes
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fractalhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Summers <rachel.summers@fractalhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-entity invoicing / remit lanes for upcoming renewal

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. As we approach our renewal (Sept–Dec usage window), we need Redwood to issue invoices that can be split across our legal entities and routed to different bank accounts based on cost center. High-level asks: 

- Single consolidated invoice per month that is tagged and sliced into line-level allocations per entity (Fractal US, Fractal EU).
- Remit lanes: Fractal US payments -> Bank A (ACH), Fractal EU payments -> Bank B (SEPA).
- VAT handling: for EU slices, include VAT registration number and reverse-charge notes where applicable.
- Cost center mapping: we need line items to carry a cost_center=string so our AP system can auto-match.

I've attached a sample ledger export (invoice_entity_map.csv) and a short remit matrix. Can you confirm:

1) Is this supported natively or do we need a custom integration?
2) Rough timeline and what data we need from our side (e.g., tax IDs, GL codes).
3) Any limitation on per-invoice line counts or attachment requirements for tax docs?

Would like to get this live before our renewal on 2027-01-01.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance, Fractal Health
liam.oconnor@fractalhealth.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: invoice_entity_map.csv (sample), remit_matrix.xlsx (sample)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fractalhealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Summers <rachel.summers@fractalhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoicing / remit lanes for upcoming renewal

Liam — thanks for the clear summary and the samples. We can support this; there are two paths depending on how much automation you want:

Option A (native split + remit lanes) — supported by Redwood Dedicated and Private: we tag line items with entity and cost_center fields, generate one PDF invoice that includes a per-entity statement and separate remit instructions for each payee. Works with SEPA/ACH lanes.

Option B (Hub connector + custom stitching) — if you prefer the invoice exported into your AP system as separate entity invoices, we can push the split rows into your AR endpoint (SFTP/ERP) and transmit per-entity invoices there.

Immediate next steps I propose: 
- Laura, can you confirm required GL field names and whether we should add a cost_center column to the billing export template?
- Rishi, we'll need UX input on the invoice PDF layout (entity header + line slices). Also flag any SSO/KMS requirements for the remit instructions.
- Liam, please confirm which path you prefer (A or B) and attach the VAT registration numbers for Fractal EU and any tax contacts.

Timeline (estimates if we have data from Fractal within 5 business days):
- Day 0–3: confirm mapping + sign SOW amendment
- Day 4–10: dev work for tagging + invoice template updates
- Day 11–15: QA + test invoice cycle with sample ledger
- Go-live: next monthly invoice cycle after successful QA

I've attached our invoice mapping template (invoice_entity_map_template.csv) — please use it to provide the cost center <-> GL mappings. I'll open a short playbook and loop in product for the PDF layout.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: invoice_entity_map_template.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoicing / remit lanes for upcoming renewal

Karthik / Rishi — quick operational notes from finance: 

- We can emit a single master invoice with a per-entity breakdown. For the AP auto-match to work on the Fractal side we need these fields at line level: invoice_id, invoice_line_id, entity_legal_name, entity_tax_id, cost_center_code, net_amount, tax_amount, tax_rate, currency, remit_account_id.

- VAT handling: for EU entries where Fractal is using reverse charge, include a tax_note field on the line and the EU VAT number in the invoice header. We will also include a VAT summary block aggregated by country.

- Limits: our renderer handles up to 2,000 lines per invoice before we recommend shredding to multiple documents for PDF performance. If Fractal's monthly usage will exceed that for a single consolidated bill, we should use per-entity invoices exported to SFTP (Option B).

- Security/compliance: Remit bank details are sensitive; redact in the UI and store in KMS. For Private deployments we can surface full instructions via the customer's secure portal.

Rishi — for the invoice PDF, recommend: 1) entity summary table at top, 2) consolidated totals, 3) per-entity statement pages with remit instructions, 4) appendix for tax notes. I'll attach a sample remit_matrix.xlsx from Fractal for mapping.

--Laura
Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
